FAQs

How do I order?

Add items to your cart, fill in your details, tap “Copy order summary”, then paste it in a DM to us on IG, Facebook or TikTok (@unscrollph). We’ll reply to confirm. We currently accept orders through DM only.

What payment methods do you accept?

We accept GCash and bank transfer.

How long does delivery take?

Orders take 3–5 business days to prepare. Local shipping via J&T Express takes 3–5 business days. International orders ship via J&T Express or PHL Post: Express takes 3–5 business days, and Regular Air Parcel takes 20–40 business days.

How much is the shipping fee?

For Metro Manila and nearby provinces, shipping usually starts at ₱75. Rates may change depending on the location and the weight of your package. We’ll confirm your exact shipping fee in the DM.

How do I track my order?

Once shipped, we’ll send you a tracking number. Enter your tracking number on the courier’s website: jtexpress.ph for J&T Express, or phlpost.gov.ph (look for Track & Trace) for PHL Post. You can also track through the J&T Express app.

Do you have other sizes?

Right now we only have pocket size (passport size), but we’re planning to add more soon. Follow us on IG, TikTok and Facebook (@unscrollph) to get updated.

Do you ship internationally?

Yes, we do international shipping! We ship through J&T Express or PHL Post. The cost is based on the destination country and the weight of the package. Once shipped, we’ll give you a tracking number you can use on their website.

What paper do you use?

Our booklets use 80 or 90gsm paper, depending on the booklet. It works well with regular pens, gel pens, pencils and most fine liners.

Can I use fountain pens?

We haven’t officially tested our paper with all types of nibs and inks, so we can’t guarantee there won’t be some show-through or bleeding, especially with wet inks or broader nibs.

How many pages do the booklets have?

Page counts vary by booklet, usually around 40–50 pages.

Do you offer discounts?

Our prices are already the best we can offer, so we can’t give discounts for now.
